reason: The cited evidence (E1) directly supports the existence of inverse Hall–Petch behavior, low friction, high wear resistance, and the formation of an ultra-nanocrystalline layer in a single-phase HEA (CoCrFeMnNi) under inert sliding conditions. However, the hypothesis extends these findings to a different alloy (FeNiCrCoCu), introduces a post-deposition annealing treatment to promote the effect, and predicts reduced serrated deformation, none of which are addressed by E1. The core mechanistic premises are supported, but the specific alloy and intervention are not.
